mission_07: Datetime columns contain rich temporal information that can be extracted into multiple useful features. Year, month, day, hour, and day-of-week capture different temporal granularities. Boolean features like is_weekend and is_business_hours encode domain-specific patterns. Cyclical encoding using sine and cosine transforms handles the circular nature of hours (23:00 is close to 00:00) and months (December is close to January). In this mission, you will extract a comprehensive set of temporal features from a timestamp column, demonstrating the full power of datetime feature engineering.
